title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar
shortDescription: Richard Garriott's moral paradigm shift where the goal is achieving ethical enlightenment across the Eight Virtues.
historicalSignificance: Revolutionized RPG design by abandoning demon-slaying in favor of moral virtue testing and player ethics.
